3463.title: Provider defaults overwrite earlier preferences
3463.rootCauseOneLine: A project-only unique key and upsert replace the previous provider settings on every provider switch.
3463.proposedFix: Migrate to provider-scoped defaults and preserve deterministic last-used provider selection.
3463.caveats: Storage reproduced twice; live UI and override fallback not exercised. Fix exceeds simple-fix limits because it needs a schema and migration change.
